widgets_values: An 800x400 pixel banner in retro 8-bit pixel art style (like classic NES Super Mario Bros). A green warp pipe from Super Mario centered in the composition, viewed from a slight top-down 3/4 angle showing the dark circular opening at the top. The pipe is the iconic bright green (#30b030) with darker green shading on the sides and a wide cylindrical rim at the top, just like in the original NES games. Colorful pixel-art data particles (blue, orange, purple small squares) float into the pipe opening, suggesting data being warped/bundled. Solid dark navy/charcoal background (#1a1a2e). Clean pixel art aesthetic with visible blocky pixels, no anti-aliasing, crisp edges. No text, no characters, no ground tiles. Just the pipe and data particles on dark background. Simple, iconic, readable at small sizes.
